title: Kingdoms of Wyrmwood
description: This is Kingdom of Wyrmwood! A MMO type Minecraft server with classes, jobs, crates and so much more!
body:
Welcome to Kingdom of Wrymwood! (KoW for short)
this server has crates, dungeons, dynamap, MMO, leveling up system, active owner, and custom items
and so much more!
Our goal is to make MMO in Minecraft a bigger and better thing!
